participant_id.Description: BIDS subject label; equal to the DANDI subject label (Pt01-Pt03, the three successful recordings of the article). Mapping: Paulk et al. 2022 Supplementary Table 1 labels the three successful recordings "Pt. 01", "Pt. 02" and "Pt. 03"; their procedure, anesthesia state and location (Pt. 01 DBS implant, general anesthesia, right dorsolateral prefrontal; Pt. 02 DBS implant, MAC and awake, left dorsolateral prefrontal; Pt. 03 left anterior temporal lobectomy, general anesthesia, left anterior temporal lobe) match the Dryad methods and the DANDI subject ids.

age.Description: Not given per participant by the source (NWB age is the cohort range P34Y/P75Y).

sex.Description: Not given per participant by the source (NWB sex 'U'; the article cohort of 9 had 7 females). Paulk et al. 2022 Supplementary Table 1 does not give sex or age per participant either.

age_range_cohort.Description: NWB general/subject/age verbatim: ISO 8601 range covering the whole 9-participant cohort (34-75 years), not the individual age.

anesthesia_state.Description: State during the recording (Dryad release methods).

procedure.Description: Surgical procedure during which the recording was made (Dryad release methods).

recorded_area.Description: Cortical area of the probe insertion (Dryad release methods).

probe_variant.Description: Neuropixels 1.0 shank variant used (Paulk et al. 2022, Supplementary Table 1, column "Type").

Levels.thick: thick-shank variant (Neuropixels 1.0-S/ST; shank 100 um thick per the ieeg.json ManufacturersModelName)
Levels.thin: thin-shank variant (Supplementary Table 1: used only in two unsuccessful attempts that are not released)

n_clusters_total.Description: Total spike-sorted clusters reported for this recording (Paulk et al. 2022, Supplementary Table 1). The spike-sorted units are not part of this LF-band release.

n_single_units.Description: Clusters classified as single units (Paulk et al. 2022, Supplementary Table 1).

n_mua_clusters.Description: Clusters classified as multi-unit activity (MUA) (Paulk et al. 2022, Supplementary Table 1).

recording_year.Description: Year of the recording. Not available: the NWB session_start_time is a placeholder (1900-01-01) and neither the article supplement nor the Dryad methods state recording dates.
